bio: Chez Louis is a friendly eatery with something for everyone. The menu features Belgian family favourites such as sole meunière and veal kidneys in mustard, as well as chef Lekeu’s more sophisticated culinary score, all of which is depicted by classical generosity. From November to February, a seafood bar is available at weekends. The extensive range of choice is undeniably one of the trump cards of this establishment, as are mussels, in season....
